mentions.name: AgentBrowser
mentions.description: A browser for agent-controlled browsing that doesn't steal focus, combining the author's Safari for day-to-day browsing with Chrome used just for development.
mentions.problem: Agent-controlled browsers steal focus, and the author had to juggle Safari for everyday browsing separately from Chrome for dev.
mentions.source_excerpt: The past week, I've started AgentBrowser because I didn't want agent-controlled browsers to steal the focus. I use Safari for day to day browser stuff and Chrome just for dev. This combines them.

evidence.value: The past week, I've started AgentBrowser because I didn't want agent-controlled browsers to steal the focus. I use Safari for day to day browser stuff and Chrome just for dev. This combines them.
